chapters.title: Getting Started
chapters.intro: Welcome to Art Studio. Discover essential workflows for setting up your canvas, picking brushes, selecting vibrant colors, and saving your work.

sections.title: Canvas & Projects
sections.body: Create projects from preset aspect ratios or custom dimensions up to 16,384 pixels. Navigate with fluid two-finger pan, pinch zoom, and rotation snapping.

sections.title: Brushes & Tools
sections.body: Select the Brush tool from the tool rail to sketch or paint. Adjust size and opacity sliders dynamically with hardware pressure sensitivity or velocity fallback.

sections.title: Colors & Palettes
sections.body: Tap the active color chip to open the Color Wheel and Palettes panel. Switch between RGB, HSV, and HSL spaces, and save custom swatches.

sections.title: Saving & Exporting
sections.body: Projects save atomically in the background with zero lag. Export finished artwork to PNG, JPEG, or WebP using Android's media gallery integration.

chapters.title: Manual Studio
chapters.intro: Harness pro-grade digital studio features including non-destructive layers, masking, blend modes, freehand selections, transforms, and interactive mesh deformation.

sections.title: Layers & Groups
sections.body: Organize art into hierarchical layer groups up to five levels deep. Reorder, duplicate, merge, or toggle layer visibility non-destructively at any time.

sections.title: Masks & Clipping
sections.body: Attach grayscale raster masks to reveal or conceal strokes without deleting pixels. Enable clipping masks to restrict content to the underlying layer silhouette.

sections.title: Blend Modes
sections.body: Select from 9 industry-standard Porter-Duff blend modes, including Multiply, Screen, Overlay, and Color Dodge, for photorealistic lighting and shading.

sections.title: Selections & Transforms
sections.body: Isolate regions with Rectangle, Ellipse, or Lasso selection tools. Scale, rotate, skew, and flip content with bilinear or bicubic interpolation.

sections.title: Deformation & Liquify
sections.body: Open the Deformation panel to warp layers with flexible grid control points or sculpt pixels smoothly using Push, Expand, and Pinch liquify brushes.

chapters.title: Brush Engine
chapters.intro: Explore realistic digital media dynamics spanning pencils, inking pens, watercolours, oil impasto, dry brushes, and customizable stamp textures.

sections.title: Paint Media Families
sections.body: Experience authentic physical media simulation. Markers feature chisel angle bleeding, watercolours diffuse into wet edge puddles, and oil brushes layer impasto ridges.

sections.title: Pressure Curves & Stabilization
sections.body: Tailor stylus feel using Linear, Soft, Firm, or S-Curve dynamics. Enable stroke stabilization to draw clean, vibration-free line art effortlessly.

sections.title: Importing Presets
sections.body: Import Krita (.kpp), MyPaint (.myb), or zip brush packs directly from the Pro Library or local storage via the Storage Access Framework.

chapters.title: Vector Tools
chapters.intro: Create scalable vector paths, geometric polygons, and editable typography objects directly alongside raster painting layers without loss of quality.

sections.title: Vector Paths & Anchors
sections.body: Draw smooth cubic Bezier paths with interactive anchor handles. Add, delete, and convert smooth or corner nodes with sub-pixel precision.

sections.title: Geometric Shapes
sections.body: Generate rectangles, circles, stars, polygons, and arrows with customizable stroke widths, miter limits, and fill colors.

sections.title: Text & Typography
sections.body: Place editable text objects using bundled open-licensed typefaces like Bubble Sans and Tomson Talks. Rasterize to standard pixel layers whenever desired.

chapters.title: Comic Tools
chapters.intro: Produce comics and manga efficiently with dedicated panel layout grids, custom gutter slicing, scalable halftone screentones, and speech balloons.

sections.title: Panel Grids & Gutters
sections.body: Generate classic 4-koma strips or action manga panels. Slice panels with angled gutters while maintaining automatic border containment masks.

sections.title: Speech & Thought Balloons
sections.body: Insert dialogue ovals, shout bursts, thought clouds, and whisper boxes. Drag curved pointer tails anywhere on the canvas.

sections.title: Screentones & Halftones
sections.body: Apply procedural dot, line, cross-hatch, and diamond halftones with controllable frequency (LPI) and angle for authentic print aesthetics.

chapters.title: Animation
chapters.intro: Bring drawings to life with frame-by-frame animation, multi-frame onion skinning, variable playback controls, and animated video export.

sections.title: Timeline & Frames
sections.body: Add, duplicate, and reorder animation frames along the timeline. Configure frame rates from 1 to 60 fps for smooth previews.

sections.title: Onion Skinning
sections.body: Preview past and upcoming frames with semi-transparent tinted overlays (red for backward, green for forward) to gauge motion timing accurately.

sections.title: Exporting Animations
sections.body: Render your completed sequence as an animated GIF or MP4 video through hardware-accelerated MediaCodec encoding.

chapters.title: AutoDraw Pipeline
chapters.intro: Analyze photographed and scanned sketches using classical computer vision to extract clean linework, segmented regions, and stroke schedules.

sections.title: Sketch Ingestion
sections.body: Import pencil sketches or inked line art. The pipeline automatically normalizes shadows, enhances contrast, and removes scanning speckles.

sections.title: Contour Tracing
sections.body: Traces crisp vector boundaries using proven border-following algorithms, iterative Douglas-Peucker simplification, and cooperative background execution.

sections.title: Playback Schedule
sections.body: Synthesizes an intelligent stroke playback timeline, reproducing your sketch stroke-by-stroke with authentic brush dabs on canvas.

chapters.title: Colour Lab
chapters.intro: Transform linework into rich, fully rendered illustrations across 16 distinct art styles using intelligent region segmentation and color palette extraction.

sections.title: 16 Distinct Art Styles
sections.body: Choose from Classic Cel, Soft Gradient, Watercolour, Comic Book, Neon Cyberpunk, Painterly, and 10 other procedural coloring recipes.

sections.title: Palette Extraction
sections.body: Extracts harmonious color swatches directly from reference photos or uses predefined mood palettes mapped to segmented subject regions.

sections.title: Bake to Editable Layers
sections.body: Bakes coloring output into 3 to 5 organized editable layers (Base Colour, Shadows, Highlights, Textures, Linework) for manual refinement.

chapters.title: File Interchange
chapters.intro: Seamlessly exchange artwork with desktop graphics software through robust support for industry-standard open formats and native project packaging.

sections.title: Native .ffart Format
sections.body: Stores complete layer trees, vector objects, blend modes, and history checkpoints inside an atomic, fault-resilient ZIP archive.

sections.title: OpenRaster (.ora)
sections.body: Export and import multi-layer artwork fully compatible with Krita, GIMP, and MyPaint with preserved layer hierarchy and blend modes.

sections.title: PSD & SVG Compatibility
sections.body: Import layered Photoshop (.psd) files safely and export vector paths as clean, scalable SVG documents adhering to web standards.

chapters.title: Pro Library
chapters.intro: Access an expanding universe of free, auditable Pro Assets with serverless public mirrors or import your own files without an internet connection.

sections.title: Serverless Downloads
sections.body: Download curated CC0 brush packs, paper textures, fonts, and comic screentones directly from GitHub, HuggingFace, and ambientCG public mirrors.

sections.title: Zero-Network Local Import
sections.body: Use the Android Storage Access Framework to import brushes, textures, and fonts stored on device storage, SD cards, or USB drives.

sections.title: Auditable Provenance
sections.body: Every bundled and downloadable pack is verified under permissive open licenses (CC0-1.0, SIL-OFL-1.1, Apache-2.0) with zero telemetry.

chapters.title: Troubleshooting
chapters.intro: Quick diagnostic solutions and recovery procedures for common storage, memory, permission, and hardware input issues.

sections.title: Low Storage & Memory
sections.body: Art Studio requires at least 1 GB free storage. Under high memory pressure, inactive tiles and undo buffers automatically flush to disk cache.

sections.title: Auto-Recovery Journal
sections.body: In the rare event of an unexpected shutdown, the recovery journal prompts to restore unsaved strokes seamlessly upon next project open.

sections.title: Stylus & Touch Diagnostics
sections.body: Open Input Diagnostics in Settings to test stylus pressure, tilt, coordinate latency, and palm rejection accuracy in real-time.
